goal: Allow clean fatal error handling instead of abrupt node crashes when disk writes fail
Prevent nodes from aborting when running out of disk space during block and undo writes
agreement: Support from contributor who hit the same write failure bug (w0xlt)
Unaddressed objection: piecemeal fixes waste review time compared to a wholesale pattern (maflcko)
Questioned whether catching write errors is preferable to immediate termination (andrewtoth)

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because stream write failures during cleanup no longer cause unexpected process termination
Core serialization and buffering primitives gain reliable exception safety on write errors

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because disk exhaustion while storing blocks triggers orderly error handling instead of an abort
Node operators facing full disks get clean shutdown diagnostics rather than unhandled crashes
